cohort: The study included 685 pregnant women attending antenatal clinics in the Sidama regional state of Ethiopia who underwent a two-hour Oral Glucose Tolerance Test for universal screening.
finding: The study found a gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) prevalence of 16.1% in the Sidama region of Ethiopia and identified urban residency, widowhood, prior abortions, prior cesarean section, gravidity, parity, and HIV status as independent risk factors.
mod_finding: A prior caesarean section was identified as an independent factor associated with GDM.
